lines: Body but entire which is form of supreme letter; this mudrā mahāmudrā of Bhairava thus in cave.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śarīraṃ tu samastaṃ yatkūṭākṣarasamākṛti eṣā mudrā mahāmudrā bhairavasyeti gahvare
